criteria.evidence: Diff adds `## [0.9.0] - 2026-08-28` with the former Unreleased content under it; an empty `## [Unreleased]` header is retained above (Keep-a-Changelog convention), which is a deviation from a literal 'replaced' but the versioned section is correctly formed.
Nearly every bullet has a period before the link, e.g. `...transitively. ([#105](...), [#106](...))` and `...gated on the policy. ([#114](...))`; criterion requires no period before the link.
Model said 'No `gh` CLI available... git log instead'; #104 appears as x/crypto bump in Housekeeping and #105 is cited on the go-git Security bullet.
Security bullets reduced to 2-4 sentences each, e.g. the materialized-object-limit bullet shrank from a long paragraph to three sentences.
All 13 Security entries from the Unreleased section remain (the workflow-permissions one moved to Housekeeping earlier, still present) and each ends with a PR link.
go-git bump appears only once, on the Security bullet; Housekeeping lists only the `golang.org/x/crypto` bump (#104).

judge.reason: The replay cut the 0.9.0 section, compressed Security, and consolidated the go-git mention, but it placed a period before the PR link on almost every bullet, directly violating c2's 'no period before the link' requirement. Additionally several PR attributions differ from the original (#109, #110, #111 are never cited, with #112 used instead), raising doubt about link accuracy though not directly scored by the criteria.
